mentions.name: ShareOurPics
mentions.description: A service for event hosts to collect guest photos through a shared link or QR code that leads to an upload page, aimed at photo gathering for weddings, parties, corporate events, and birthdays.
mentions.problem: Existing photo-gathering services are unintuitive ("too complicated for Grandma"), too featureful, and/or much too expensive.
mentions.audience: Event hosts collecting guest photos for occasions like weddings, parties, and corporate events
mentions.source_excerpt: A focused and functional service for event hosts to collect guest photos through a shared link/QR code that leads to an upload page. Think photo gathering for weddings, bachelor/bachelorette parties, corporate events, big birthdays, etc.
mentions.author: lrobinovitch
